shared_elements: low-relief animal with arched back and bent, angular legs
animal carved on the shaft of a large upright slab/pillar with a distinct horizontal upper block
schematic outline relief with flat interior
justification: Both surfaces show a schematic profile quadruped in flat low relief, with elongated body, arched back and angular bent legs, placed on the broad face of an upright slab beneath a projecting horizontal upper element, which is a fairly specific shared convention. The decisive difference is density and composition: A is a crowded multi-register scene combining several animals, a human-like figure, a bird, a zigzag/net band, plant-like motif and repeated rectangular signs interacting with one another, whereas B presents a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank field with no relationships to other elements.
